title: Melting Blue Creature
description: A large amorphous blue creature with big yellow eyes and a downturned mouth sits in the foreground, melting and dripping onto a flat surface. Behind it looms a giant dark blue crescent moon against a purple and orange gradient sky, with numerous colorful dripping shapes, symbols and small creatures hanging from the top of the frame.
prompt: A surreal scene featuring a large amorphous blue melting creature with oversized sad yellow eyes and a downturned mouth, dripping heavily onto the ground. A giant glowing dark blue crescent moon dominates the background against a purple and orange sunset sky. Numerous smaller colorful dripping shapes, eyes, moons, and symbols hang from the top of the image like melting ornaments, in a whimsical yet melancholic painterly style with visible drips and splatters.
